note: The first state worked off the federal gap list. 21 RIDB rows, 13 of them likely_rv by catalog; 12 added, 1 excluded. Recorded so a later pass does not re-offer what was already judged. AWH 2026-09-21 called in the three the first pass had withheld — the two closed campgrounds and the one whose site length could not be confirmed — to be added with the caveat written into the note instead, so the entry carries the warning rather than the campground being invisible.

added.name: Lake Wedington Recreation Area
added.caveat: CLOSED until further notice as of Sept 2026, infrastructure damage; stated in the note

added.name: Notrebes Bend (Arkansas River)
added.caveat: CLOSED as of Sept 2026, and none of its 30 sites is bookable; stated in the note

added.name: Blue Ridge Park (Dierks Lake)

recheck.why: Two entries carry a closure that is expected to lift. Re-read their recreation.gov pages before a trip is planned around either, and clear the closure sentence from the note once they reopen.
